title: How is a world model different from an LLM?
summary: LLMs predict language; world models predict environmental change and action consequences.
body: An LLM primarily predicts what comes next in language. A world model predicts how an environment may change in response to an action. Language models organise linguistic patterns; world models aim to represent state, dynamics, actions and consequences.
